subject: Community Preservation Act Annual Public Hearing
overview: The committee held its annual public hearing to review program progress, project priorities for the upcoming fiscal year, and the integration of CPA goals with the city's comprehensive plan. The body also set the timeline for the next funding round and introduced a new full-time Community Preservation Act manager.

items.title: Introductions and Personnel Changes
items.summary: The committee introduced new CPA Manager Teresa Dupont and new member Reg Graham representing the Park Commission.

items.title: CPA Program Overview and Financial Report
items.summary: Chair Roberta Cameron presented a review of the program's history, noting approximately $10 million invested in 80 projects and a projected revenue of $2.1 million for the upcoming fiscal year.

items.title: Planning Initiatives and Comprehensive Plan Alignment
items.summary: Staff discussed implementing parks projects at Carr and Gillis Parks and the need to align future CPA funding with the newly adopted city comprehensive plan.

items.title: Community Priorities and Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: The committee debated the future relationship between CPA funding and the newly established Affordable Housing Trust, including the potential for delegating fund management to the trust board.

items.title: Historic Preservation and Public Benefit
items.summary: Members discussed leveraging CPA funds for historic sites that serve as public spaces and the challenges of funding long-term restoration at the Brooks Estate.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2024 Funding Round and Timeline
items.summary: Approved a revised grant cycle timeline with applications due August 1, incorporating previously deferred commitments of $400,000 for the McGlynn School and $800,000 for Walkling Court.

items.title: Administrative Goals and Website Redesign
items.summary: The committee established administrative priorities for the new manager, focusing on project oversight, financial record-keeping, and updating the project map and website.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Committee Vacancies
items.summary: Approved the March 14, 2023 meeting minutes and noted upcoming vacancies for representatives from the Conservation Commission and Community Development Board.
